basic.name: I Want to Help
basic.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Clara's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Svarog Watches Over You
skill.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{skill_damage}}% of Clara's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals Physical DMG equal to {{skill_damage}}% of Clara's ATK to enemies marked by Svarog with a Mark of Counter. All Marks of Counter will be removed after this Skill is used

ultimate.name: Promise, Not Command
ultimate.description_template: After Clara uses Ultimate, DMG dealt to her is reduced by an extra {{damage_reduction}}%, and she has greatly increased chances of being attacked by enemies for 2 turn(s). In addition, Svarog's Counter is enhanced. When an ally is attacked, Svarog immediately launches a Counter, and its DMG multiplier against the enemy increases by {{mv_increase}}%. Enemies adjacent to it take 50% of the DMG dealt to the primary target enemy. Enhanced Counter(s) can take effect 2 time(s).

talent.name: Because We're Family
talent.description_template: Under the protection of Svarog, DMG taken by Clara when hit by enemy attacks is reduced by 10%. Svarog will mark enemies who attack Clara with his Mark of Counter and retaliate with a Counter, dealing Physical DMG equal to {{folllow_up_damage}}% of Clara's ATK.

technique.name: A Small Price for Victory
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, the chance Clara will be attacked by enemies increases for 2 turn(s).

2.name: Kinship
2.description: When attacked, this unit has a 35% fixed chance to dispel 1 debuff placed on them.

4.name: Under Protection
4.description: Increases the chance to resist Crowd Control debuffs by 35%

6.name: Revenge
6.description: Increases DMG dealt by Svarog's Counter by 30%

eidolons.name: A Tall Figure
eidolons.description: Using Skill will not remove Marks of Counter on the enemy

eidolons.name: A Tight Embrace
eidolons.description: After using the Ultimate, ATK increases by 30% for 2 turn(s)

eidolons.name: Cold Steel Armor
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Family's Warmth
eidolons.description: After Clara is hit, the DMG taken by Clara is reduced by 30%. This effect lasts until the start of her next turn.

eidolons.name: A Small Promise
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Long Company
eidolons.description: After other allies are attacked, Svarog also has a 50% fixed chance to trigger a Counter on the attacker and mark them with a Mark of Counter. When using Ultimate, the number of Enhanced Counters increases by 1.
